what: the concrete stair east of the house, as one average step
where_it_stands: John, 2026-08-14. The bearing is right. The flight sits half its width south of where the photograph fit put it, and its north edge is in line with the south edge of the roof.
how_that_was_applied: cabin.js puts the roof at (-34.17, -7.03) turned 18.2 deg, 8.17 m across the ridge by 8.49 along, eaves included. Its south edge runs from world (-36.72, -1.72) to (-28.96, -4.28). The flight was moved along its own across axis until its north edge lay on that line: 0.74 m toward 164 deg, against the 0.60 half-width John judged by eye.
the_step_itself_is_still_the_old_fit: going, rise and the position along the flight come from tracing twelve tread edges off the frame below, and that trace used the front door camera aimed 11.28 deg up. The aim was corrected to 0.81 on 2026-08-13. Across the flight the placement is now John's; along it and in the size of a step it is not settled, and the projected nosings do not yet sit on the photographed ones.
not_measured: the width, taken as 1.2 m, and the difference between one step and the next, which John says is real and this does not know
steps_and_tread_are_John's: nineteen steps, tread about ten inches. Those two were never fitted.

bottom.ground_m_note: The lidar at the foot is 12.04. The flight is set 0.09 lower so it rides the ramp rather than climbing off it, which puts every step within a quarter of a metre of the ground.
